How can I adjust the flavors of the sauce if it's too lemony or has too much of a wine taste?: Introducing: alfredo sauce's badass older sister. I started things off with a heavy cream base and added in lemon juice/zest, garlic powder and then brie & parmesan cheese. Oh, and white wine because wine and cheese and pasta is everything!
​Bring water to a boil and cook whatever kind of pasta you're using according to package directions.
Put a skillet on the stove and turn the heat up to medium. Add in the butter, heavy cream, garlic powder, wine, lemon juice and zest. Mix with a whisk.
It should start to bubble after a few minutes, when this happens, add in the brie and parmesan cheese. Whisk until the cheese has melted and the texture is thicker like an alfredo sauce.
Taste test the sauce. Add salt/pepper if you'd like. If it's too lemony or there's too much of a wine taste, add more cream. If it's lacking lemon or wine taste, add in more of either of those.
Pour over the hot pasta and top with lemon zest, crispy garlic and brie wedges.
output:
If the sauce is too lemony, try adding more heavy cream to balance out the acidity of the lemon. You can also try adding a pinch of sugar to neutralize the tartness.

If the sauce has too much of a wine taste, try reducing the amount of white wine used in the recipe. You can also try adding more cheese or heavy cream to mellow out the wine flavor.

Remember to taste test the sauce frequently and adjust the flavors accordingly. Don't be afraid to experiment and make small adjustments until you find the perfect balance of flavors for your taste preferences.

4. Fontina: This Italian cheese is similar to brie in texture and adds a nutty and earthy flavor to the sauce.

5. Feta: This crumbly cheese can be used as a substitute for parmesan, and it adds a salty and tangy flavor to the sauce.

Remember to adjust the amount of cheese used based on the type you choose, as some cheeses may be stronger in flavor than others.

Question/Instruction: Summarize the significance of Mourinho's words after Manchester United's victory against Manchester City.

Given material: As the Manchester United players sat in the Etihad dressing room, facing up to the worst possible humiliation and maybe a defining bad day for the team, Jose Mourinho came up with what were evidently the best possible words for what now might be a defining good day.
"You don’t want to be the clowns standing there, watching them get their title," the Portuguese said.
Mourinho had actually come up with similar words the last time he was in such a situation, when Chelsea so epically denied Liverpool in April 2014. This isn’t completely the same context, and the words may indicate that the United job may end up differently than the one at Chelsea, too.
Those words, after all, did two things.
Firstly, they inspired the team to a vintage and glorious comeback, one that was so visibly relished.
They secondly showed that the players are still listening to him, that his words really registered - that he got a positive reaction out of them.
The latter is why this could be a genuinely significant victory for the Mourinho reign.
One of the undercurrents of a generally underwhelming season from United has been that the Portuguese’s abrasive man-management approach would eventually burn the team out, just as it did at Chelsea and Real Madrid, and compound and combine with some of his other flaws as manager.
This, however, proved that that prospect looks very far off. What’s more, that his words got that reaction - with Chris Smalling making a point of mentioning it after the game - will only further burnish his standing in the eyes of the squad; help create that bit of an aura around him again.
That will actually be all the more pronounced because the first half was so profoundly bad.
That is why this should really not be underestimated.
It should really have been 5-0 at half-time, as United were completely torn apart, and facing up to what would have been one of the most embarrassing days for the club. They would have been, as Mourinho put it, 'the clowns'. The sad clowns who so pathetically and haphazardly allowed their local rivals to walk all over them for the easiest of title-clinching wins. Those are the sort of defeats that can start to destroy a side, as everyone starts looking around for who to blame for such an embarrassment.
They were instead looking for people to celebrate. What could have been one of the worst days for the club turned into what was really the best possible outcome in the circumstances… and the sort of win that starts to bond a side together. That is what victories like this do.
There’s also the fact this was a victory like from United’s best days, a classic stirring comeback. The way that evokes the club’s rich history will only further embolden the players; strengthen those links. They will feel that, yes, this is the team they’re supposed to be.
To actually go and win the game, there was the significant second-half improvement in some of the most discussed and under-scrutiny players: Paul Pogba and Alexis Sanchez.
United won with their best attackers released, and playing their best attacking football.
One grand caveat is that a lot of this was undeniable circumstantial. Those attackers had to attack.
It remains to be seen whether Mourinho will release them more generally, and there are of course still very fair doubts whether the Portuguese can co-ordinate an attack in the modern way now required at the top level.
The core of his teams has always been that intense competitiveness, something that is a value for any team, and this match showed he can still derive it from his players.
It showed that the fundamentals of a team are there.
Whether Mourinho can actually overtake City in the long term is another question, of course. This win emphasised that, at the very least, the foundation for such an assault is there. There have been many times when that didn’t look the case, but the encouragement now will be to build on it, to make sure it always looks like that from now on in. This win will greatly help in that.
United were anything but clowns, there to be humiliated. They ended up as warriors, who reduced the champions elect to some real humility.
Independent.ie sportsdesk On an evening of painful blows on the field, a jibe from the stands might have been the hardest thing for Arsenal fans to take.
output: Mourinho's words after Manchester United's victory against Manchester City were significant. His statement, "you don't want to be the clowns standing there, watching them get their title," inspired the team so much that they went on to make a glorious comeback in the second half of the game. His words also showed that the players are still listening to him, which is a positive sign for the Mourinho reign. The victory highlighted that the fundamentals of the team are in place and the foundation for an assault on City is there. This win is a significant boost for Mourinho and his team, and it will greatly help them in their future games.

instruction: Can you provide more insight into how Mourinho's words affected the team's performance?
output:
Mourinho's words after Manchester United's victory against Manchester City had a significant impact on the team's performance. His statement, "you don't want to be the clowns standing there, watching them get their title," was a motivational trigger that pushed the players to come out and play with more confidence and intensity in the second half. Here is a piece of text: The daughter of legendary architectural photographer Julius Shulman remembers that, as a child growing up in Los Angeles, her father wasn't particularly eager to show her the city's landmarks. Judy McKee says, in fact, that she first remembers seeing Angels Flight with her neighbors. But in discussing her father's affection for Los Angeles, McKee leaves no doubt. Julius Shulman loves the varied neighborhoods, landscape and innovative architecture of L.A.
He is, she says, just as passionate about his dislike of over-commercialization and endless tract developments.
The just opened exhibit "Julius Shulman's Los Angeles" at the Los Angeles Public Library's Getty Gallery is a love letter (albeit a complex one) from Shulman to his city. The show is a survey of the city's development. Included are some of Shulman's most iconic images such as "Case Study House #22" (1960) and "Chemosphere" (1960). Viewers unfamiliar with Shulman's work may be surprised at the wide-ranging scope of his photographic wanderings. He takes us to Wilshire Boulevard, the Watts Towers, LAX, Hollywood Reservoir, and yes, even to Angels Flight. There are images of the San Fernando Valley and Baldwin Hills.
He expresses his disdain for cookie-cutter tract housing in a 1960 photograph of a neighborhood With oil fields in the distance. His dismay at the destruction of private homes in favor of office buildings downtown is evident in "The Saltbox and the Castle, the Last Remaining Houses on Bunker Hill" (1967), shown here.
Although Shulman fulfilled his duty to the clients who retained his eye, I was struck in this show by how he also communicated his personal feelings about the effect architecture has on a city and, ultimately, on the people who reside there.
If Los Angeles had a list of municipal treasures, Shulman would certainly be on it. As a resident since 1920, he has been a keen observer and documentarian of the city's architectural history and growth. His images of California Modernist architecture, made in the 1950's and 1960's, define that period as much as the buildings themselves do. When Shulman began his career as a professional photographer in 1936 (through a now-famous chance encounter with architect Richard Neutra) he had no way of knowing what kind of impact his images would ultimately have. This exhibit at the Central Library displays the passion Shulman feels for Los Angeles and the persistence of his razor-sharp vision in expressing it.
On Nov. 7 at 7 pm in the library's Mark Taper Auditorium, Shulman will discuss his life and the city with the Getty Institute's Wim de Wit, co-curator of the exhibition. It's part of the Aloud series. "Julius Shulman's Los Angeles" can be viewed at the LAPL Getty Gallery until January 20.
Photo: Used with permission. Julius Shulman Photography Archive, Research Library at the Getty Research Institute.

The exhibit includes some of Shulman's most iconic images and expresses his personal feelings about the effect architecture has on a city and its residents. Shulman's love for Los Angeles, as well as his disdain for over-commercialization and endless tract developments, is evident throughout the exhibit. instruction: This guide is really helpful! Can you add some more information about how to measure success metrics? What are some specific metrics that we should be looking at to gauge the success of our content marketing strategy?
output:
Sure! Measuring success metrics is an essential aspect of any content marketing strategy. Here are some specific metrics that you should be looking at to gauge the success of your content marketing strategy:

1. Website Traffic: One of the most common metrics used to measure content marketing success is website traffic. Use tools like Google Analytics to track the number of visitors to your site and measure how it changes in response to your content marketing efforts.

2. Engagement: Engagement metrics measure the extent to which your audience interacts with your content. Look at metrics like shares, comments, and likes on social media and blog posts to determine how engaging your content is.

3. Time on Site: Analyze the amount of time visitors spend on your website. The longer visitors stay on your site, the more engaged they are with your content. Use this metric to understand which pages or topics are most engaging to your audience.

4. Conversions: Conversions are the ultimate goal of any content marketing strategy. Measure the number of leads, sales, and conversions that result from your content marketing efforts.

5. Return on Investment (ROI): ROI measures the profits generated from your content marketing investments. It's an essential metric to determine whether your content marketing efforts are generating a positive return on investment.

6. Audience Growth: As your content marketing strategy drives traffic and engagement to your website, it should also increase your audience size. Monitor the growth of your email list, social media followers, and other relevant metrics to determine if your content marketing is driving audience growth.

By monitoring these metrics, you can gain insights into the effectiveness of your content marketing strategy and adjust your approach as needed for optimal results.

How does eBay Inc. Incorporate big data into its shopping and auction website, and what role do data sandboxes play in this process? Answer according to: Data Science and Data Sandbox: eBay Inc.
Data sandbox may not be a term some are familiar with. When it comes to Big Data, it means a developmental and scalable platform companies use to explore data sets via collaboration and interaction. A data sandbox enables a company to realize its existing investment value as it relates to Big Data.
Data science teams are the ones that explore a data sandbox and acquire sandbox platforms from logical partitions or analytic stand-alone data marts within enterprise data warehouses. The best part about data sandbox platforms is that they offer the computing necessary for tech professionals like data scientists to handle frequently multifaceted analytical workloads.
eBay Inc. Incorporates Big Data into its shopping and auction website. With over 300 million active items at any given time and over 100 million site users, data sandboxes act as a key component for the company and its efforts to maintain steady and reliable data analysis. In order to keep ahead of user demand, eBay Inc. Has its own data analytics platform made up of a Teradata-based EDW or enterprise data warehouse allowing the company the ability to store a separate ‘deep storage’ and structure transaction data. The platform is named Singularity and holds semi-structured information containing analyses of site user behavior plus other types of machine-generated text and information.
Along with EDW, eBay grants it employees ‘data sandboxes’ of 100 GB of space to enable room to play in. These analytics sandboxes are user-controlled and walled-off allowing for experimentation of separate data. This kind of experimentation can lead to advanced analytic models and development of other significant intellectual property. Data sandboxes allow the growth of the most valuable resource in any company using Big Data, talented people along with better management of Big Data.
output: In summary, eBay Inc. Utilizes data sandboxes as a developmental and scalable platform for exploring large data sets via collaboration and interaction. The company's own data analytics platform, Singularity, is based on a Teradata-based EDW and holds semi-structured information on user behavior and machine-generated text. Employees are granted data sandboxes of 100 GB for experimentation with separate data, leading to the development of advanced analytic models and intellectual property. By using data sandboxes, eBay is able to better manage and analyze its vast amounts of data while encouraging the growth of talented individuals in the field of Big Data.

instruction: Can you provide more examples of how eBay Inc. Uses data sandboxes to improve its platform and user experience?

By experimenting with different algorithms and data sets in a sandbox environment, eBay can fine-tune its recommendations and provide a more personalized experience for each user.

2. Fraud detection: eBay is constantly monitoring its platform for fraudulent activity, such as fake listings or sellers. Data sandboxes allow eBay's data science team to experiment with new machine learning models and algorithms for detecting fraud, without risking disruption to the live site. By catching more instances of fraud, eBay can improve the trust and safety of its platform for all users.

3. Search optimization: eBay processes millions of search queries every day, and optimizing search results is critical to providing a smooth user experience. By continually improving search, eBay can help users find what they're looking for faster and more accurately.

Overall, data sandboxes enable eBay to experiment and innovate with Big Data in a risk-free environment, allowing the company to improve its platform and user experience in meaningful ways.

instruction: Create a step-by-step tutorial for a DIY project that demonstrates how to upcycle old mason jars into unique and decorative flower vases using a specific decorative style of your choosing. Include a list of necessary materials and tools, recommended techniques for cleaning and preparing the jars, and a series of simple yet precise instructions for transforming the jars into visually appealing vases that can be used for any type of flowers or plant arrangements. Ensure that the tutorial is easily understandable for beginners and offers a clear sense of the finished product.
output:
DIY: Upcycled Mason Jar Flower Vases

Materials:

- Old mason jars
- Decorative paper napkins
- Mod Podge glue
- Paintbrush
- Scissors
- Sandpaper
- Optional: spray paint

Instructions:

Step 1: Remove any labels or stickers from the mason jars using hot water and soap. You can also use rubbing alcohol or vinegar to remove any sticky residue.

Step 2: Use sandpaper to create a rough surface on the outside of the jar. This will help the Mod Podge glue stick better.

Step 3: Cut out images or designs from your chosen decorative paper napkins. You can use a single design or mix and match different patterns to create a unique look.

Step 4: Apply a thin layer of Mod Podge glue to the outside of the jar using a paintbrush. Make sure the entire surface is covered.

Step 5: Carefully place the cut-out designs onto the glue-covered surface. Smooth out any wrinkles or bubbles with your fingers.

Step 6: Apply another layer of Mod Podge over the top of the designs to seal them in place. Let the glue dry completely.

Step 7: Optional: If you want to add a pop of color to your vases, you can spray paint the lids or the rims of the jars in a coordinating or contrasting color. Let the paint dry completely.

Step 8: Fill your new flower vase with water and add your favorite blooms! 

And there you have it—your very own unique and upcycled mason jar flower vase! These vases make great decor for your home or a thoughtful gift for a friend. Give it a try and show off your creativity!

instruction: Can you recommend any other materials to use besides paper napkins?
output:
Certainly! If you don't have paper napkins, or if you want to use a different material for your upcycled mason jar flower vases, here are a few other options you could try:

- Fabric scraps: You can cut out designs from colorful or patterned fabrics, and use Mod Podge glue to apply them to the jars. This would give your vases a fun, quilted look. - Tissue paper: Layering different colors of tissue paper can create a cool stained glass effect on your mason jars. Simply cut small squares or rectangles of tissue paper, and glue them to the jar with Mod Podge. - Washi tape: If you have a collection of washi tape, you can use it to decorate your mason jars with stripes, polka dots, or other patterns. Just wrap the tape around the jar in whatever design you like. - Twine or yarn: For a rustic, boho look, you can wrap twine or yarn around the jars and secure it with glue. You could also create a macrame-style design by knotting the twine or yarn in different ways. These are just a few ideas to get you started! The possibilities for upcycling mason jars are endless, so have fun experimenting with different materials and techniques.

instruction: In a minimum of 500 words, provide a thorough explanation of the process of cellular respiration, including the specific stages involved, the role of enzymes and other molecules, and how ATP is produced. Additionally, discuss the importance of cellular respiration in sustaining life and powering various cellular processes, and provide examples of how disruptions to this process can impact organisms. Use scientific language and provide supporting evidence from reliable sources.
output:
Cellular respiration is the process by which living cells convert energy stored in food into a form that the cells can use to perform their functions. This process involves several stages and requires the help of enzymes and other molecules. The goal of cellular respiration is to produce ATP (adenosine triphosphate), which is the main energy source that cells use to power various processes.

The first stage of cellular respiration is glycolysis. This process occurs in the cytoplasm and breaks down glucose (a type of sugar) into two molecules of pyruvate. This process does not require oxygen and produces a small amount of ATP. Glycolysis also generates NADH, a molecule that carries electrons to later stages of cellular respiration.

The second stage of cellular respiration is the citric acid cycle, also known as the Krebs cycle. This process occurs in the mitochondria and begins with the breakdown of pyruvate. The pyruvate is converted into acetyl-CoA, which enters the cycle. During the Krebs cycle, the acetyl-CoA is broken down into carbon dioxide and water, releasing energy that is used to produce ATP. The Krebs cycle also generates NADH and FADH2, which are molecules that carry electrons to the next stage of cellular respiration.

The third stage of cellular respiration is oxidative phosphorylation. This process occurs in the mitochondria and uses the energy stored in NADH and FADH2 to produce ATP. During oxidative phosphorylation, electrons are passed from NADH and FADH2 to a series of enzymes called the electron transport chain. As the electrons move through the chain, they release energy that is used to pump protons (H+) across the inner mitochondrial membrane. This creates a electrochemical gradient, which is used to produce ATP through a process called chemiosmosis.

Enzymes play a crucial role in cellular respiration. These molecules catalyze the chemical reactions that occur at each stage of the process. For example, the enzyme hexokinase is required for the first step of glycolysis, which involves phosphorylating glucose. Other enzymes are responsible for breaking down pyruvate, running the Krebs cycle, and producing ATP through oxidative phosphorylation.

Other molecules are also important in cellular respiration. For example, oxygen is required for oxidative phosphorylation, as it is the final electron acceptor in the electron transport chain. In the absence of oxygen, cells cannot produce ATP through this process and must rely on less efficient forms of energy production.

The importance of cellular respiration in sustaining life cannot be overstated. This process is the means by which cells generate the energy they need to perform essential functions such as growth, repair, and movement. Without cellular respiration, cells would quickly run out of energy and cease to function.

Disruptions to cellular respiration can have serious consequences for organisms. For example, some toxins and poisons interfere with the electron transport chain, preventing cells from producing ATP through oxidative phosphorylation. This can lead to a buildup of toxic molecules that can damage cells and cause tissue damage. Diseases such as cancer also involve disruptions to cellular respiration, as cancer cells often rely on less efficient forms of energy production to fuel their growth and proliferation.

In conclusion, cellular respiration is a complex process that enables cells to convert energy stored in food into a form that can be used to power essential cellular processes. This process involves several stages and requires the help of enzymes and other molecules. ATP, the main energy source for cells, is produced through oxidative phosphorylation, which relies on the electron transport chain and chemiosmosis. Disruptions to cellular respiration can have serious consequences for organisms, emphasizing the vital importance of this process in sustaining life.

instruction: Thank you for explaining the process of cellular respiration so clearly. Can you please elaborate more on the importance of ATP in sustaining life and powering various cellular processes?
output:
Certainly! ATP (adenosine triphosphate) is essentially the "energy currency" of cells. It is the molecule that provides the energy needed for almost all cellular processes, including metabolism, movement, and growth. The breakdown of ATP into ADP (adenosine diphosphate) releases energy that is used to power these processes.

Without ATP, cells would quickly run out of energy and be unable to perform their essential functions. Even a small disruption to ATP production can have serious consequences for an organism. For example, if there is insufficient oxygen available for oxidative phosphorylation (the process that produces the majority of ATP), cells may switch to less efficient forms of energy production such as fermentation. This can cause a buildup of lactic acid and other waste products, which can damage cells and tissues.

ATP is also essential for maintaining the cell's internal environment. Many cellular processes, such as the maintenance of ion gradients and the synthesis of macromolecules, require energy in the form of ATP. The breakdown of ATP can also provide the energy needed for active transport mechanisms, which allow cells to move molecules against their concentration gradients.

In addition to powering cellular processes, ATP has other important functions. For example, ATP can act as a signaling molecule that regulates various processes within the cell. It can also bind to proteins and alter their conformation, allowing them to perform their functions.

Overall, the importance of ATP in sustaining life and powering cellular processes cannot be overstated. This molecule provides the energy needed for cells to perform their essential functions and maintain their internal environment. Any disruption to ATP production or utilization can have serious consequences for an organism.

instruction: Provide a step by step guide on how to make a gluten-free dessert option, including all ingredients and measurements required. The recipe should be easy to follow and the dessert should be both delicious and visually appealing. Make sure to also include any necessary substitutions for ingredients that are typically not gluten-free.
output:
Gluten-Free Raspberry Almond Bars

Ingredients:

- 1 and 1/2 cups almond flour
- 1/4 cup coconut flour
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter, at room temperature
- 1/2 cup erythritol or coconut sugar
- 1 tablespoon vanilla extract
- 1/4 teaspoon salt
- 1/2 cup raspberry jam

Instructions:

1. Preheat your oven to 350°F. Line an 8-inch square baking pan with parchment paper or grease it with coconut oil.

2. In a medium bowl, mix together the almond flour and coconut flour.

3. In a large bowl, cream the butter, erythritol, vanilla extract, and salt with an electric mixer until light and fluffy.

4. Add the flour mixture to the butter mixture and stir until well combined. You might need to use your hands to knead the dough a few times to make it come together.

5. Press about two thirds of the dough evenly into the bottom of the prepared baking pan. Use your hands or a spatula to smooth it out.

6. Spread the raspberry jam over the crust.

7. Break the remaining dough into small pieces and sprinkle it on top of the jam.

8. Bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until the edges are golden brown.

9. Remove from the oven and let cool completely in the pan before cutting into squares.

Substitutions:

- Almond Flour - Use another nut flour, such as hazelnut, pecan or walnut flour.
- Coconut Flour - Use gluten-free all-purpose flour, oat flour, or tapioca flour.
- Unsalted Butter - Substitute for vegan butter or coconut oil if dairy-free or vegan option is desired.
- Erythritol - Substitute coconut sugar, maple syrup, or honey, but note that the flavor and texture of the final product may differ.
- Raspberry Jam - Use any other kind of fruit jam or spread that is gluten-free.

Question/Instruction: What is the background to the suspension of Percy and why have his opponents sought to oust him?

Given material: It is a quintessential institution of the establishment, producing 13 British prime ministers, 10 chancellors of the exchequer and 17 archbishops. Among its former students are King Edward VII, Albert Einstein, Lewis Carroll and WH Auden. One fictional alumnus, Lord Sebastian Flyte, came to personify its privileges in the pages of Evelyn Waugh’s Brideshead Revisited.
But Christ Church, one of Oxford’s most venerable colleges, was plunged into turmoil last week when its dean was suspended from duties and barred from taking services at his own cathedral after being challenged under archaic and opaque rules.
A formal complaint has been filed against the Very Rev Martyn Percy with the college’s governing body. Few people know details of what is being alleged, or who is behind the move. Even Percy is largely in the dark, according to his friends. After publication of this article, lawyers for Christ Church said in a letter to the Observer that Percy and his legal advisers had been sent the complaint, dated 17 September 2018, and supporting documentation. An internal tribunal had been set up to investigate in accordance with the college’s statutes, the letter said.
The complaint is believed to centre on issues of governance; no one is suggesting improper personal conduct. The tribunal could dismiss Percy. A date for a hearing is yet to be set.
The background, according to his supporters, is the dean’s efforts to modernise the arcane management of the college and reform its pay structures. They say his opponents want to oust him in order to preserve traditional hierarchies and privileges. One described Christ Church as a “medieval fiefdom”. Another said there was “no doubt” the dean was being bullied and intimidated.
Percy, who has presided over the college and the cathedral it contains for four years, is said to be deeply distressed by the complaint. He took several weeks of sick leave, and has lost a significant amount of weight, according to friends.
He has also been forced to spend thousands of pounds to hire lawyers for the tribunal and could face financial ruin.
Last week Percy was suspended as dean of both college and cathedral, even though the complaint relates only to his college duties. The action means he is banned from presiding over services at the cathedral of the Oxford diocese in the run-up to Christmas, one of the busiest and most important times of the year.
In a statement, the college’s governing body said: “Ahead of an internal tribunal, which will review a formal complaint, the dean of Christ Church, the Very Rev Professor Martyn Percy, has been suspended from his duties pending the tribunal’s outcome.
The university of Oxford said the dispute was internal to Christ Church, but in a statement it described Percy as a “widely respected member of the university community”. The situation “must be deeply regrettable for all concerned”, it added.
The Church of England is not involved in the tribunal and there is no question of a clergy disciplinary measure. However, reflecting the level of concern, the bishop of Oxford, Steven Croft, briefed members of the diocesan synod on Saturday.
The substance of the complaint has not been discussed on or off the record by anyone involved, and Percy did not respond to a request for comment, and has not spoken to the media about the matter.
His supporters, however, have rallied to his defence. Angela Tilby, the author and priest who is a canon emeritus of Christ Church, said Percy had sought to speed up reform at the college. “He wanted Christ Church to be more inclusive, more open to the outside world, and, perhaps, more aware of its wealth and vested interests,” she wrote in Church Times.
The complaint against Percy was made to the governing body of Christ Church, made up of 64 people, mostly cathedral canons and college faculty. The tribunal will be composed of members of the governing body presided over by an independent chair.
In the past, Percy has irked the Church of England hierarchy by criticising its reform programme, which he said was “driven by mission-minded middle managers” who were alienating clergy, congregations and the general public.
Last year, he intervened in a row over the newly appointed bishop of Sheffield, saying Philip North’s opposition to female priests would “cause significant pastoral and public damage to the church”. Two weeks later, North stood aside.
The Charity Commission, which has oversight of Christ Church as a charitable institution, said it was aware of “issues around the governance and leadership” at the college.
“Allegations of bullying are taken extremely seriously by the Commission. We expect the trustees to take meaningful steps to address the issues and keep us updated on developments,” said a spokesperson.
• This article was amended on 28 November 2018 to clarify the headline and add a further response from Christ Church received after publication.

Percy's opponents are believed to be seeking his ousting in order to maintain traditional hierarchies and privileges. The complaint filed against Percy is believed to revolve around his modernisation attempts and reforms to the college's pay structures, rather than any issue of improper personal conduct. The tribunal, which has been set up in accordance with the college's statutes, could dismiss Percy. instruction: How does extreme weather events, such as hurricanes or wildfires, impact communities?
output:
Extreme weather events, such as hurricanes or wildfires, can have severe impacts on communities. 

1. Property damage and loss- Extreme weather can cause significant property damage or complete destruction. It can leave people without homes, resulting in displaced individuals and communities.

2. Economic impacts- Businesses can suffer from damage to their facilities, loss of inventory or customers, and disrupted supply chains due to extreme weather events. Small businesses and low-income households are often disproportionately impacted.

3. Health risks- Extreme weather events can affect the health of individuals with respiratory or cardiac conditions, and diseases can spread from contaminated floodwaters, insects, and animals that thrive in warmer climates.

4. Psychological distress- Extreme weather events can lead to an increase in stress, depression, and anxiety among individuals and communities. It can also lead to a sense of helplessness and hopelessness.

5. Loss of life- Extreme weather events can cause fatalities either directly or indirectly, such as through floods, downed power lines or trees, and road accidents.

In summary, the impacts of extreme weather events can be long-lasting and can have a significant impact on the overall well-being of communities.

instruction: It sounds like extreme weather events can cause a lot of damage. What can communities do to prepare for them?
output:
You are absolutely right! Extreme weather events can cause significant damage to communities. To minimize the impacts of these events, communities can prepare by taking proactive measures to reduce the vulnerability of homes, businesses, and public infrastructure. Below are some steps that a community can take to prepare for extreme weather events:

1. Develop an emergency plan- Develop a plan that outlines how the community will respond to an emergency event, and ensure that all residents and businesses are aware of the plan. The plan should include evacuation routes, emergency shelters, and communication channels.

2. Identify vulnerable areas- Identify areas in the community that are at most risk of damage, and take measures to mitigate these vulnerabilities.

3. Maintain public infrastructure- Ensure that public infrastructure such as roads, bridges, and dams are regularly inspected and maintained to reduce the risk of failure during extreme weather events.

4. Educate the community- Conduct outreach to communities to educate them about the risks of extreme weather events and provide them with resources to prepare for these events.

5. Create community-based emergency response teams- Create a team of community members who will help manage the response to an emergency event. These teams can help with evacuation, distribute information, and provide support to those in need.

Overall, it is essential for communities to have a comprehensive emergency plan in place, and to prepare for the worst-case scenarios in advance to minimize the impact of extreme weather events.

Here is a piece of text: A motorcyclist who died following a crash near Portadown was described as “an affable and outgoing fellow” at his funeral on Sunday.
Nathan Doran, a 22-year-old from Lurgan, was a former pupil of Lismore Comprehensive who worked close to the Dobbin Road between Portadown and Armagh where the crash happened at around 10.30pm on Wednesday.
Police said Mr Doran’s motorcycle collided with a car driven by an older lady.
He was laid to rest in St Colman’s Cemetery on Sunday afternoon, following Requiem Mass at St Paul’s Church.
Fr Brian Fitzpatrick, in a touching homily, described him as “the magnet that attracted and the glue that united people one to another”.
“Questions of how did this happen begin to surface through the numbness and the shock that comes first, and the question of why did it happen will be one that we struggle with in the weeks and months to come,” he said.
“The tragedy of accidents on our roads tells us that all kinds of people get caught up in these cruel circumstances. And for so many of them it is as cruel and as random as simply being in the wrong place at the wrong time,” Fr Fitzpatrick told mourners at St Paul’s.
“But it does make it all the harder to accept, for Nathan was a lad who loved life and had so much to live for. Anybody who knew him knew him to be a pleasant young soul with a big heart who would do anything to help you.
“He was an affable and outgoing fellow, a lad who would speak to anybody. The cheeky smile that he always wore made it easy to approach him and get to know him.
“I get the feeling that he knew that he knew he was a good-looking youngster, and he took great pride in his appearance, perfectly grooming the hair and making sure that the beard was clipped and always choosing a sharp jacket and shirt for heading out.

instruction: Write a captivating story with a strong plot about a brave and daring astronaut who embarks on a perilous mission to explore the far reaches of space. Use vivid descriptions and sensory language to create a rich and immersive setting that truly showcases the vastness and mystery of the cosmos. Ensure that the protagonist is well-developed and relatable, with clear motivations and a compelling backstory that drive their actions throughout the tale. Finally, make sure to include plenty of high-stakes action, suspenseful twists and turns, and moments of awe and wonder to keep the reader engaged from start to finish.
output:
Captain Sarah Morrison had always been fascinated by the cosmos. Ever since she was a little girl, she dreamt of becoming an astronaut and exploring the stars. Her parents had always encouraged her to follow her dreams, and now, after years of rigorous training, she was finally ready to embark on her most daring mission yet.

Sarah had been chosen to lead an exploration mission to the far reaches of space, a region of the galaxy that had never been explored before. She would be the first human being to set foot on an alien planet, and the potential for groundbreaking discoveries was immense.

As Sarah boarded her spacecraft, she couldn't shake the feeling of excitement that gripped her. She had trained for years for this moment, and she was ready to face whatever challenges lay ahead.

The journey to the undiscovered planet was long and arduous, but Sarah's determination never wavered. She spent every moment studying the data collected by her ship's instruments, searching for any sign of life on the planet ahead.

Finally, the ship arrived at its destination, and Sarah put on her spacesuit, ready to take a step into the unknown. As she stepped out onto the planet's surface, she was struck by the utter silence that surrounded her. The sky was a deep shade of purple, and the ground beneath her feet was covered in an iridescent layer of crystals that glimmered in the planet's dim light.

Sarah explored the planet, taking careful notes of every detail she observed. She discovered massive rock formations that seemed to defy gravity, and strange creatures that slithered across the ground, their bodies glowing with an otherworldly light.

But as Sarah continued her explorations, she began to realize that this planet was far more dangerous than she had initially thought. The strange creatures became increasingly aggressive, and Sarah had to fight for her life on more than one occasion. There were moments when she thought she would never make it back to her ship alive.

But Sarah remained determined. She knew that the risks were worth it, that the discoveries she made could change the course of human history. And finally, after weeks of exploration, she discovered something truly incredible.

Buried deep beneath the planet's surface was an ancient artifact, a device that seemed to hold within it the secrets of an advanced civilization that had existed long before the first humans.

As Sarah studied the artifact, she felt a sense of awe wash over her. The wonders of the cosmos were truly endless. And though her mission had been perilous, she knew that the discoveries she had made would change the world forever.

Sarah returned home a hero, celebrated as a brave and daring explorer who had ventured to the far reaches of space to uncover secrets that had remained hidden for eons. And years later, when she looked up at the stars, she knew that there was still so much left to discover.

instruction: Give detailed instructions on how to make a classic cheeseburger.
output:
Ingredients:
- 1 pound ground beef (80% lean)
- Salt and pepper
- 4 burger buns
- 4 slices of cheese
- Toppings: lettuce, tomato, onion, pickles, condiments of your choice

Instructions:

1. Preheat your grill or a frying pan over medium-high heat.

2. Divide the ground beef into four equal portions, and shape each portion into a ball. Flatten each ball to create a patty that is about ½ inch thick.

3. Sprinkle both sides of the patties with salt and pepper.

4. If using a grill, oil the grates with some vegetable oil to prevent the patties from sticking. If using a frying pan, add a bit of oil or butter to the pan.

5. Place the patties on the grill or pan, and cook for about 4-5 minutes on each side. If you prefer your burger more well-done, you can cook it a bit longer.

6. Add a slice of cheese on top of each patty during the last minute or so of cooking, and allow it to melt.

7. While the patties are cooking, prepare the buns by slicing them in half and toasting them lightly (optional).

8. Assemble the burgers by placing a patty with melted cheese onto the bottom half of each bun. Add your choice of toppings, such as lettuce, tomato, onion, and pickles.

9. Spread your preferred condiments on the top half of each bun, such as ketchup, mayonnaise, or mustard.

10. Cover the burgers with the top half of the bun, and serve hot.

Enjoy your classic cheeseburger!

instruction: Can you give me some tips on choosing the right type of cheese?
output:
Of course! Choosing the right type of cheese is very important when making a cheeseburger, as it can greatly affect the flavor and texture of your burger. Here are some tips to help you choose the right type of cheese:

1. Consider the flavor: The cheese you choose should complement the flavor of the beef patty. For a classic cheeseburger taste, choose a mild and creamy cheese like American cheese or cheddar. If you prefer a stronger cheese flavor, you can try Swiss, blue cheese or provolone. 2. Consider the meltability: Choose a cheese that melts easily and evenly when added to a hot patty. Good choices for melting include American cheese, cheddar, mozzarella, pepper jack or provolone. 3. Experiment with different cheeses: Don't be afraid to try different types of cheese to find your favorite. Some people like to try different cheese combinations or add adventurous options like brie or feta. 4. Keep it simple: Sometimes simple is best, and you can never go wrong with classic American cheese or cheddar on your cheeseburger. Remember, the type of cheese you choose will depend on your personal preference, so feel free to experiment and try different types of cheese until you find the perfect combination for your cheeseburger.

instruction: Want an alternative to deep fried samosas? Are you sick of excessively flaky curry puffs that leave a trail of flakes everywhere? Then this recipe is for you! These samosas are made from Malaysian paratha dough and are pretty easy to make. They can be filled with just about anything – beef kheema, chicken kheema, spiced potato, or any leftover dry salan. They make wonderful snacks for kids as well. In fact, my kids gobbled up all of the samosas the minute they came out of the oven! Prepare the filling. I made beef kheema with peas. Using a knife, cut the dough into quarters. Set aside one quarter piece. Each paratha makes four samosa triangles. This step is important!! Do not completely thaw the parathas, make sure they are quite cold and semi-frozen. As you work with it, it will start to thaw. If they become too thawed, the dough will become very sticky and impossible to work with. If you notice your dough thawing too quickly stick it back in the freezer for a minute. Take one spoon of filling and place it on the dough. Fold the dough over the filling carefully, press the edges together and crimp with a fork. Place the samosas on an ungreased cookie sheet. Place in an oven set to 350 degrees for about 20 minutes, checking on them regularly. Samosas are done when they are golden brown like this. Remove from cookie sheet and place on a plate to cool. Note: Malaysian parathas can be purchased from any Indo-Pak supermarket. They are found in the freezer aisle. Do you think this would be ok with the regular parathas (uncooked ones) as well? I think the samosas would work best with the Malaysian paratha dough because the multiple layers cause it to rise slightly and “puff” up. In addition, the outer layer forms a crisp shell. These parathas are also nice and flaky. I am pretty sure you would not be able to achieve those effects with regular paratha dough. Good luck! Mine turned out soooo good! Better than regular fried somosa. Seriously! And ten times easier. No hassle with sealing them. No oily mess with frying them. So simple so delish. P.S. I used frozen uncooked plain style parathas. These just came out of the oven and look so good. The idea is just genius! My daughter is eagerly waiting another few minutes for iftar to try them out. So I just found your site and I’m obsessed with it MashaAllah! waiting for my kids to sleep so I can enjoy it in peace lol This is such a wonderful idea, I can’t wait to try it! Malaysian paratha dough, what brand and where can I buy it from? Sorry for the late response. You can find it at any Indian grocery store in the freezer section. Some Middle Eastern grocery stores may have it as well. What is the recommended filling for these samosas, and how should they be prepared?
output: You can use any filling you like for these samosas. Some traditional options include spiced potato, beef or chicken kheema, or leftover dry salan. For the beef kheema filling, brown ground beef in a skillet and add diced onion, garlic, ginger, and peas. Season with garam masala, cumin, coriander, and turmeric to taste. Cook until the veggies are tender and the beef is cooked through. Allow the filling to cool before using it to fill the samosas.

instruction: Thank you for the instructions on how to make the beef kheema filling for the samosas. Can you suggest any vegetarian filling options that would work well with these samosas?
output:
Of course! Here are a few vegetarian filling options for the samosas:

1. Aloo Gobi: This classic Indian recipe combines potatoes and cauliflower with a blend of aromatic spices.

2. Paneer and Peas: Paneer is an Indian-style cheese that is perfect for stuffing inside samosas, along with some peas and spices.

3. Spiced Lentils: Cook lentils with onion, garlic, and your favorite spices (like cumin, coriander, and turmeric) to create a flavorful vegetarian filling.

4. Spinach and Cheese: Saute spinach with some garlic and ginger, then mix with your favorite cheese (like feta or paneer) to create a tasty filling.

These are just a few ideas to get you started. Feel free to experiment with your favorite vegetables and spices to create your own unique samosa filling!

instruction: Write a narrative story that follows a group of childhood friends exploring a mysterious island for the first time. Make sure to include details about the island's landscape, the challenges they face, the discoveries they make, and how their friendship strengthens throughout their adventure. The story should be written in a descriptive and engaging style, focusing on character development and creating a sense of suspense and excitement as the friends uncover the island's secrets.
output:
Once upon a time, there were four childhood friends who were eager to explore a mysterious island that lay just beyond the horizon. They had always heard stories about the island, with its lush tropical landscape and secret caves, but no one had ever ventured there before.

The friends' names were Maya, Jake, Emily, and Alex. They had grown up together, playing hide-and-seek and tag in the meadows near their small town. They had always been fascinated by adventure and mystery, and the island seemed like the perfect challenge.

So the friends set out one bright morning, sailing towards the island in a small dinghy. As they drew closer, they could see the island's rugged shoreline, with its towering cliffs and gnarled trees. The water was crystal clear, and they could see schools of colorful fish darting around beneath the waves.

The friends landed their boat on a sandy beach, and as they stepped ashore, they were struck by the island's beauty. There were bright flowers everywhere, and tall palm trees swayed in the breeze. The sun beat down on their backs, and Maya could feel the sweat starting to trickle down her neck.

As they made their way across the beach, they came across a rocky outcrop. Alex was the first to clamber up, and he shouted down to the others that he could see something glittering up ahead.

The others scrambled over the rocks, and as they turned a corner, they saw a small waterfall cascading down into a hidden lagoon. The water was so clear that they could see the rocks and plants beneath the surface, and they stripped off their clothes and dove in.

The lagoon was cool and refreshing, and they splashed around for hours, playing water games and diving off the rocks. But as the sun began to dip towards the horizon, they realized that they needed to find a place to camp for the night.

They walked further along the beach, and soon came across a cave that looked like it might make a good shelter. But as they entered the cave, they realized that they weren't alone.

There were strange, glowing mushrooms growing on the walls, and the floor was littered with bones. Suddenly, they heard a low growl, and a pair of glowing eyes stared at them from the darkness.

It was a wild boar, snarling and snapping its teeth. The four friends backed away slowly, but the boar charged at them, its razor-sharp tusks glinting in the dim light.

Jake grabbed a stick and brandished it at the boar, yelling at the others to run. They scrambled out of the cave as fast as they could, their hearts pounding with fear.

They ran along the beach, panting and sweating, until they finally collapsed in a heap. They had never been so scared in their lives, but they realized that they were in this together. They had each other to rely on, and their friendship gave them the strength to face whatever challenges lay ahead.

The group spent a restless night on the beach, but in the morning, they set out to explore more of the island. They found a series of underground waterfalls, a hidden pirate treasure, and even a small village inhabited by friendly locals.

As they explored the island, their friendship deepened and grew, and they realized that they had created some unforgettable memories together. They eventually made their way back to their small town, but they knew that the island would always hold a special place in their hearts.

And although they never forgot the fear and excitement of those first few days on the island, they also knew that their friendship was even stronger than they had ever imagined.

instruction: What are some best practices for building a strong brand identity?
output:
1. Define Your Brand Identity: You should have clarity on what your brand stands for, what values your brand represents, and the personality of your brand.

2. Understand Your Target Audience: You should have a deep understanding of your target audience, their needs, and their behaviours.

3. Develop a Unique Brand Voice: Develop a tone of voice that is consistent across all communication channels.

4. Be Consistent with Brand Messaging: Your messaging should be consistent across all channels, ensuring that your audience understands your brand.

5. Create a Strong Visual Identity: Your brand identity should be visually appealing with a strong logo, typography, colours, and imagery.

6. Ensure Brand Consistency: Ensure all brand elements are consistent in all communications, including social media, website, and marketing materials.

7. Leverage Multiple Communication Channels: Be consistent in your communication across multiple channels, including your website, social media, emails, and other marketing materials.

8. Allow Room for Flexibility: While staying true to your brand identity, be flexible enough to customize your communication and messages for different contexts or demographics.

9. Monitor and Adapt: Keep track of your brand performance regularly and proactively adapt to evolving trends and customer needs.

10. Engage with Your Audience: Engage with your audience and create meaningful connections with them, through social media and customer support, for example.

instruction: I think social media is a great way to build brand identity. What are some tips for effective social media branding?
output:
Sure, here are some effective tips for social media branding:

1. Know Your Target Audience: You need to understand your target audience, including their interests, behaviours, and preferences to create relevant and engaging social media content.

2. Stay Consistent: You should ensure that all your social media accounts maintain consistency in terms of brand messaging, voice, and visuals.

3. Use Strong Visuals: You should use high-quality images, videos, and graphics that are visually appealing and on-brand.

4. Engage Your Audience: Social media is a two-way communication channel, so make sure to actively engage with your audience by responding to comments and messages while encouraging conversation around your brand.

5. Share Valuable Information: Share informative and educational content related to your industry to maintain an authority in your field.

6. Leverage Influencers: Partner with social media influencers who align with your brand values and target audience to increase your brand's reach and credibility.

7. Track Performance and Adapt: Track your social media performance regularly and analyze insights to measure the effectiveness of your strategy. Adapt your strategy as needed to optimize your social media branding efforts.

8. Experiment: Don't be afraid to try new things and experiment with different types of content or social media platforms to see what works best for your brand.

instruction: This tutorial is great, but could you please provide more information on how to choose the right container for the candles? Also, do you have any tips on how to store the finished candles properly?
output:
Sure! Here are some tips on how to choose the right container for your candles and how to store them properly:

Choosing the Right Container:
- Look for containers that are heat-resistant and non-flammable, such as glass jars, metal tins, or ceramic vessels.
- Choose a size that fits the amount of wax you want to use and the purpose of the candle. For example, small jars are great for travel candles, while large jars are ideal for long-lasting and decorative candles.
- Consider the shape and style of the container, as it can affect the way the candle burns and how the fragrance is spread. A wider container will allow for a wider pool of wax, while a taller container will create a stronger scent throw. You can also experiment with different shapes, such as hexagons or cylinders, for a unique look.

Storing the Finished Candles:
- Keep your candles away from direct sunlight, heat sources, or cold temperatures, as they can affect the quality and texture of the wax and fragrance.
- Store your candles in a cool and dry place, such as a pantry or a closet, where they can avoid moisture, dust, or odors.
- Avoid stacking or overcrowding your candles, as they can get scratched or damaged. If you need to store multiple candles, use a separate box or shelf to keep them organized.
- Label your candles with the fragrance name, date of creation, and any other relevant information, so you can keep track of their shelf life and quality.
- Always trim the wick before lighting the candle again, and never burn the candle for more than 4 hours at a time.

instruction: Thanks for the tips on choosing the right container and storing the finished candles. Could you please provide some additional information on how to add colorants to the melted wax? Can I use food coloring or do I need a specific type of dye for candles? Also, how do I know how much colorant to add?
output:
Sure, here's some additional information on adding colorants to your candles:

Adding Colorants:
- Natural colorants such as spices, herbs, or clays can be added directly to the melted wax to create a subtle and textured hue. For example, you can use cinnamon or turmeric for a warm yellow, beetroot or pomegranate for a pink or red, or spirulina or matcha for a green or blue.
- If you want a more intense and consistent color, you can use candle dyes that are specifically designed for wax. These dyes come in liquid, powder, or block form and are usually made of synthetic or natural ingredients that dissolve well in wax. You can find them online or at craft stores.
- Avoid using food coloring or other non-candle dyes, as they can cause the wax to become cloudy, separate, or fade over time. They can also affect the scent and burn quality of the candle.
- Assess the amount of wax you want to color and follow the manufacturer's guidelines on how much dye to use per pound of wax. As a general rule, you can start with 1-2 drops of liquid dye or a pinch of powder dye and adjust the amount based on the desired shade. Remember that the color may appear slightly different when the wax solidifies, so test a small amount first.

Tip: If you want to create a marble or swirl effect with different colors, you can pour the wax in layers or mix the colors using a toothpick or a skewer.

Here is a piece of text: A study from the 90s showed that about one-third of U.S. Senators were investors, and as a group they enjoyed an abnormal rate of return. Is it time for an update?
Q. (for U.S. Senate candidates): If elected (or re-elected), would you invest in individual stocks, including those that fall directly under the jurisdiction of committees on which you serve?
Ted Stevens, the senior Republican in the Senate, who has represented Alaska since 1969, invests in dozens of individual stocks, including telecommunications and technology companies within the jurisdiction of the Commerce Committee, which he chairs.
In contrast, Richard Lugar of Indiana, a Republican senator for 28 years who chairs the Foreign Relations Committee, decided on entering politics in 1967 that "holding individual stocks was incompatible with public service. Lugar invests only in diversified mutual funds, and each year releases a balance sheet of his assets and liabilities that goes well beyond what is legally required."
"According to a study conducted by four business professors, in any given year between 1993 and 1998 roughly one-third of all senators played the stock market, and those who did enjoyed an ‘abnormal’ rate of return, meaning they out-performed the market.
“Senators consistently anticipated movements in stock prices: they often purchased stocks just before prices took off like a rocket, and revealed an uncanny ability to sell just when a stock was about to flatten out.
"For some perspective, the authors of the study (university professors Alan Ziobrowski from Georgia State; Ping Cheng from Florida Atlantic; James Boyd from Kent State; and Brigitte Ziobrowski from Augusta State) compared the senators' performance with that of two groups. The first is the investing public: 66,465 randomly selected households in the United States that were studied in 2000.
This group under-performed the market by approximately 1.4 percent annually from 1991 to 1996. The authors also compared the senators' performance with a 2001 study of corporate insiders during the period 1975 to 1996. This group beat the market by about 6 percent annually—lending credence to the old Wall Street adage that you rarely go wrong if you buy and sell when the insiders do.
"Yet being a corporate insider, and presumably trading on the basis of privileged information, apparently pales next to being a senator. The Ziobrowski et al. Study found that senators (including their spouses and dependents) outperformed the market by around 10 percent annually.
"'Nobody gets results like this in the financial world consistently and over the long term,' notes Professor Tom Ferguson, who studies money in politics at the University of Massachusetts-Boston. Any manager of a mutual fund, in fact, who regularly beats the market by as little as two percent annually is considered an investment genius."

output: Ted Stevens invests in dozens of individual stocks within the jurisdiction of the Commerce Committee, which he chairs, while Richard Lugar invests only in diversified mutual funds and has not held individual stocks since entering politics in 1967. Lugar believes that holding individual stocks is incompatible with public service and releases a balance sheet of his assets and liabilities each year that goes beyond what is legally required. This is in contrast to Stevens, who invests in individual stocks and has been found to enjoy an abnormal rate of return along with about one-third of all senators who played the stock market, according to a study by four business professors.

instruction: Can you provide more information about the study by the four business professors?
output:
The study by four business professors (Alan Ziobrowski from Georgia State, Ping Cheng from Florida Atlantic, James Boyd from Kent State, and Brigitte Ziobrowski from Augusta State) looked at the stock market performance of US senators between 1993 and 1998. They found that in any given year, about one-third of all senators played the stock market and enjoyed an "abnormal" rate of return, suggesting that they outperformed the market. Moreover, the senators consistently anticipated movements in stock prices, buying stocks just before prices took off and selling just when a stock was about to flatten out. 

The authors of the study compared the senators' performance with two other groups: the investing public (66,465 randomly selected households in the US studied in 2000), who underperformed the market by about 1.4% annually, and corporate insiders (studied from 1975 to 1996), who beat the market by about 6% annually. Senators, however, outperformed the market by around 10% annually, including their spouses and dependents. These findings suggest that senators had a strategy for investing that allowed them to outperform the market, which is not typical of the investing public. The authors of the study note that consistent and long-term results like this are hard to achieve in the financial world, and any manager of a mutual fund who beats the market by as little as 2% annually is considered an investment genius.

output:
A user-friendly interface with clear organization and color-coded priority levels can greatly enhance the usability and efficiency of a software application. The interface should be easy to navigate and understand, ensuring that users can quickly access the features they need.

By using color-coded priority levels, the software can help users determine which tasks or items are most important or urgent. For example, using red to denote high priority tasks and green for low priority tasks can help users prioritize their workload and ensure they are focusing their efforts on the most critical tasks.

Clear organization is also essential to ensure that users can easily find what they are looking for. Grouping related functionality and information in logical sections or tabs can help users navigate the application more quickly and efficiently.

Overall, a user-friendly interface with clear organization and color-coded priority levels can improve the user experience, maximize productivity, and help users stay on top of their work.

instruction: This is helpful information, but can you elaborate more on how color-coding can benefit the user experience? And maybe give some examples of other software applications that use this feature effectively?
output:
Sure, I can provide more details on the benefits of color-coding and give examples of software applications that use this feature effectively.

Color-coding can benefit the user experience in several ways. Firstly, it can help users distinguish between different types of content, making it easier to scan and find relevant information. For instance, using a different color for each type of file format or document can help users quickly differentiate between them.

Secondly, color-coding can be used to highlight important information or tasks that require attention. This can be particularly useful in project management software where users need to manage multiple tasks with varying levels of urgency. By using colors such as red or orange for high-priority tasks, users can quickly identify the most critical items on their to-do lists.

Finally, color-coding can also be used to create a visual hierarchy, guiding users' attention to the most important and relevant content. For example, in a calendar app, using different colors for different types of events (e.g. Work, personal, holidays) can help users quickly see their schedule at a glance.

Some software applications that use color-coding effectively include:

1. Trello - a project management app that uses color-coded labels to highlight the status of tasks.

2. Google Calendar - a calendar app that uses different colors for different types of events.

3. Evernote - a note-taking app that uses colored tags to categorize and organize notes.

4. Slack - a communication app that uses different colors to indicate the status of team members (e.g. Green for available, red for away).

Overall, color-coding can be a powerful tool for improving usability and user experience in software applications. By using colors effectively, developers can help users navigate content more efficiently and make informed decisions.

However, could you add some more information on the impact of VR technology on student learning outcomes and engagement? I'd also like to know more about the potential applications of VR technology in other fields apart from STEM, social studies, and language learning.
output:
Absolutely, thank you for your feedback.

Impact of VR on Learning Outcomes and Engagement

Numerous studies have demonstrated the positive impact of VR technology on the learning outcomes and engagement of students. For example, a study conducted by the University of British Columbia found that using VR technology to teach expository writing led to better student engagement and writing performance than traditional methods. Another study found that VR technology is particularly effective in teaching spatial skills, which can enhance students' ability to visualize and understand complex concepts.

Moreover, research conducted by the University of Barcelona found that using VR technology in English language classes resulted in increased engagement and communication skills among students. The immersive environment of VR technology provides students with an engaging learning experience that promotes active participation and deep learning. By simulating real-life scenarios and experiences, students can develop problem-solving skills, adaptability, and decision-making abilities.

Potential Applications of VR Technology in Other Fields

Apart from STEM, social studies, and language learning, VR technology has potential applications in various other fields such as:

1. Healthcare Education

VR technology can be used to simulate medical procedures, surgical techniques, and emergency situations, providing a safe and cost-effective alternative to traditional training methods. Medical students can use VR technology to study anatomy, physiology, and biochemistry in a more immersive and interactive way.

2. Art and Design Education

VR technology can be used to simulate art galleries, museums, and exhibitions, providing students with an immersive art experience. Moreover, it is an excellent tool for architecture and design students to visualize and manipulate 3D models.

3. Business and Marketing Education

VR technology can be used to provide practical training in business management, marketing, and sales. For example, students can use VR technology to simulate sales pitches, customer interactions, and product demonstrations.

Conclusion

In conclusion, VR technology offers numerous benefits in education, including an immersive learning environment, virtual field trips, and remote learning. The technology has the potential to improve student engagement, learning outcomes, and retention of concepts. Additionally, VR technology has applications in various other fields such as healthcare, art, and business education, providing students with practical and immersive learning experiences. While the high cost, technical issues, and health concerns associated with VR technology can be limitations, the potential benefits have significant implications for education in the future.

instruction: Write a fictional short story of at least 500 words about a young adult who, after stumbling upon an old journal in a forgotten attic, discovers they are a descendant of a long-lost race of beings with unique elemental powers. The story should include vivid descriptions of the protagonist’s journey discovering and developing their powers, including any challenges or obstacles they encounter along the way. Additionally, incorporate themes of self-discovery, identity, and acceptance as the protagonist grapples with their newfound abilities and their place in the world. Bonus points for incorporating elements of fantasy or mythology into the story.
output:
Cassie had always felt like she was different from everyone else. Growing up, she struggled to fit in with her classmates and struggled to form meaningful relationships with others. She often spent her time alone, lost in her own thoughts and imagination, discovering different worlds and characters in her mind.

One day, while helping her parents clean out their attic, Cassie stumbled upon an old journal hidden away in a dusty old chest. As she opened the pages, she realized that the journal belonged to a long-lost ancestor, dating back several hundred years. The journal chronicled the journey of a young woman much like Cassie, who had discovered that she was a descendant of a long-lost race of beings with unique elemental powers.

As Cassie began to read the journal, she couldn't help but feel a deep sense of longing and connection to the young woman's story. She felt like she had found a part of herself that she hadn't known existed.

The journal mentioned that the elemental beings had the power to control the forces of nature. They could manipulate water, control fire, and command the winds. Cassie was fascinated by the idea of having such powers, and soon found herself delving deeper into the journal, studying the ancient texts and legends of her ancestral people.

She began to notice that she could feel the elements around her in a way that she never had before. She felt the earth tremble beneath her feet, and the wind whispered in her ear. She felt the warmth of the sun on her skin, and the coolness of the water as it flowed over her fingertips.

As Cassie continued to explore her newfound powers, she realized that she had a special gift for controlling the elements. She could create small whirlwinds of air, and call forth bursts of flames from thin air. She could summon a storm of lightning at will, and even control the growth of plants with her touch.

However, Cassie soon learned that her powers were a double-edged sword. As she began to explore her abilities, she discovered that there were those who wanted to control and exploit her for their own purposes. She met other beings who also had elemental gifts, some of whom used their abilities for destructive purposes.

Cassie realized that her journey was not just about discovering and developing her powers, but also about finding her place in the world. She struggled with questions of identity, wondering if she would ever fully fit in or if she would be forever an outsider.

As she grappled with these issues, Cassie also began to realize that her powers gave her a unique perspective on the world. She saw things that others could not, and she understood the interconnections between all things in a way that few others did.

Ultimately, Cassie learned that the most important thing was to accept and embrace herself for who she was, powers and all. She discovered that she was not alone in her journey, and that there were others like her who had struggled with similar issues of identity and self-discovery.

With time and practice, Cassie learned to control her powers and use them for good, protecting and defending those who could not defend themselves. She found a sense of purpose and fulfillment, and became a true force of nature in her own right.

As she looked back on her journey, Cassie realized that her powers had given her a gift that went beyond mere elemental control. Her journey of self-discovery and acceptance had opened doors to new worlds and possibilities, and she was forever grateful for the journey that had led her to that dusty old journal in the forgotten attic.

instruction: This is a great start, but could you add more descriptive details about Cassie's journey? I want to feel like I'm right there with her as she discovers her powers and faces obstacles.
output:
Certainly! Here is an expanded version:

Cassie's heart raced as she read the journal's pages, feeling a rush of excitement and disbelief as she learned about her ancestors' powers.
